nodes.text: Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a common respiratory virus causing cold-like symptoms. It can affect all ages but poses higher risks for young children, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals. While most cases are mild, HMPV can lead to severe respiratory infections.
